item.title: Hello, world!
item.description: Hello people of the world! For the past 5 months, ever since the YouTube stream went down, Lumi and I have been talking about what to do with the radio and how it will proceed. Pretty much from the get-go, we knew that a return to YouTube was going to be unlikely and that the radio had to change. Back then, I took it upon myself and had a working proof of concept ready within a day for a radio stream over Icecast (an audio stream server) and got working.
